home.title: Choose your workspace
home.intro: TriageLane suggests a priority at the registration desk, keeps a live queue per department, and lets nurses verify and override in one tap. Every decision has a reason and an audit entry.
home.levelsTitle: Three lanes, always with icon and label

roles.reception: Register patients, pick symptoms, print token slips.
roles.nurse: Live lanes, vitals, verify, reorder and override.
roles.doctor: Your sorted queue with reasons and vitals.
roles.admin: Rules, catalogue, settings, analytics and audit.
roles.display: Token numbers and now serving, for the hall screen.

disclaimer: Decision support for queue ordering. Thresholds are based on published triage frameworks and require clinical validation before real deployment. TriageLane does not diagnose and does not replace clinical judgement. Demo uses synthetic data only.
